headline: 1 Healthcare Stock to Research Further and 2 We Avoid
summary: From novel pharmaceuticals to telemedicine, most healthcare companies are on a mission to drive better patient outcomes. Shareholders who bet on the industry have been rewarded lately as healthcare stocks have returned 9.7% over the past six months, topping the S&P 500 by 1.8 percentage points.
